Build two features for Rankora at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora`: **Interview Scheduling** + **Job Board Posting**.

Read CLAUDE.md first. Then read these files before coding:
- `src/components/JobDetailView.tsx` — main job view
- `src/components/CandidateDetailSheet.tsx` — candidate detail panel
- `src/components/candidate/EmailOutreachDialog.tsx` — existing email dialog
- `src/pages/CareerPage.tsx` — career page with JSON-LD
- `src/pages/CareerJobDetail.tsx` — job detail page with JSON-LD
- `supabase/functions/send-candidate-email/index.ts` — email sending pattern
- `supabase/functions/send-email/index.ts` — if exists, email helper

---

## Feature A: Interview Scheduling

### What to build
A Calendly-style interview scheduling system where recruiters set their availability and candidates can self-book interview slots.

### DB Migration — `supabase/migrations/20260408900000_interview_scheduling.sql`

```sql
-- Recruiter availability slots
CREATE TABLE public.availability_slots (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  team_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  day_of_week integer NOT NULL CHECK (day_of_week BETWEEN 0 AND 6), -- 0=Sun, 6=Sat
  start_time time NOT NULL,
  end_time time NOT NULL,
  timezone text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC',
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CHECK (start_time < end_time)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_availability_user ON public.availability_slots(user_id, day_of_week);
ALTER TABLE public.availability_slots ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "Users can manage own availability" ON public.availability_slots FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (user_id = auth.uid());
CREATE POLICY "Team members can view team availability" ON public.availability_slots FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (public.is_team_member(auth.uid(), team_id));

-- Scheduled interviews
CREATE TABLE public.interviews (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  job_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  resume_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.resumes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  interviewer_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  candidate_name text NOT NULL,
  candidate_email text,
  scheduled_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  duration_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled' CHECK (status IN ('scheduled', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'no_show')),
  meeting_link text,
  notes text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_interviews_job ON public.interviews(job_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_interviews_interviewer ON public.interviews(interviewer_id, scheduled_at);
ALTER TABLE public.interviews ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "Team can view interviews" ON public.interviews FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.jobs j LEFT JOIN public.team_members tm ON tm.team_id = j.team_id AND tm.user_id = auth.uid() WHERE j.id = interviews.job_id AND (j.user_id = auth.uid() OR tm.user_id IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE POLICY "Team can manage interviews" ON public.interviews FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (interviewer_id = auth.uid() OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.jobs j WHERE j.id = interviews.job_id AND j.user_id = auth.uid()));

-- Public booking tokens
CREATE TABLE public.booking_tokens (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  job_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  resume_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.resumes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  interviewer_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token text NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(24), 'hex'),
  duration_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now() + interval '7 days'),
  used boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.booking_tokens ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Interviewers can create tokens" ON public.booking_tokens FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (interviewer_id = auth.uid());
```

### Availability Settings — `src/components/AvailabilitySettings.tsx`

Available from Settings page or Profile page.

Props: `userId: string, teamId: string`

Features:
- Weekly grid: 7 days × time slots
- For each day: toggle active/inactive, set start time and end time (e.g., Mon 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM)
- Timezone selector (dropdown of common timezones)
- Default duration: 30 min (configurable)
- Save to `availability_slots` table

UI: Simple table/grid with time inputs per day:
```
Day         Active   From      To
Monday      [x]      09:00     17:00
Tuesday     [x]      09:00     17:00
Wednesday   [x]      09:00     17:00
...
```

### Schedule Interview Dialog — `src/components/ScheduleInterviewDialog.tsx`

Triggered from candidate detail or KanbanBoard when moving to "interview" stage.

Props: `open, onOpenChange, jobId, resumeId, candidateName, candidateEmail`

Features:
- Select interviewer (team members dropdown)
- Select date (calendar picker)
- Show available time slots for that interviewer on that date (computed from availability_slots minus existing interviews)
- Duration selector (15, 30, 45, 60 min)
- Optional meeting link (manual input — for Google Meet / Zoom)
- Optional notes
- "Send booking link to candidate" toggle — if enabled, generates a booking token and sends email with self-serve booking link
- "Schedule directly" button — creates interview record immediately

### Public Booking Page — `src/pages/BookInterview.tsx`

Route: `/book/:token` — public, no auth

Features:
- Fetch booking token details from DB (via edge function or RPC)
- Show: interviewer availability for next 2 weeks, job title, candidate's name
- Candidate selects a date → sees available time slots → picks one → confirms
- On confirm: creates interview record, marks token as used
- Success screen: "Interview scheduled for [date] at [time]"

### Edge Function — `supabase/functions/book-interview/index.ts`

Public endpoint for booking page to fetch slots and confirm booking.

GET `?token=...` → returns available slots
POST `{ token, selected_time }` → creates interview, marks token used, sends confirmation email

### Interviews Panel — `src/components/candidate/InterviewsPanel.tsx`

Shows in CandidateDetailSheet alongside notes and scorecards.

Props: `resumeId, jobId`

Features:
- List of scheduled interviews for this candidate
- Each: date/time, interviewer, duration, status badge, meeting link
- Status actions: mark complete, cancel, no-show
- "Schedule Interview" button → opens ScheduleInterviewDialog

### Integration

- Add AvailabilitySettings to Settings page
- Add InterviewsPanel to CandidateDetailSheet
- Add ScheduleInterviewDialog trigger in CandidateDetailSheet
- Add `/book/:token` route to App.tsx (public, outside MaintenanceGate)
- Show upcoming interviews count in the job detail view header

---

## Feature B: Job Board Posting / Distribution

### What to build
Indeed XML feed + optimized social sharing. Full API integration with job boards is complex and requires partner agreements, so we focus on what's immediately achievable:

1. **Indeed XML Feed** — auto-generated XML feed URL that Indeed can crawl
2. **LinkedIn sharing optimization** — proper OG tags for rich link previews
3. **Job posting quick-share** — one-click share buttons for major platforms
4. **Google Jobs optimization** — already have JSON-LD, enhance it

### Indeed XML Feed — `supabase/functions/indeed-feed/index.ts`

Public endpoint that returns XML in Indeed's expected format.

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<source>
  <publisher>Rankora</publisher>
  <publisherurl>https://rankora.co</publisherurl>
  <lastBuildDate>Wed, 08 Apr 2026 12:00:00 GMT</lastBuildDate>
  <job>
    <title>Senior Frontend Engineer</title>
    <date>Wed, 24 Mar 2026</date>
    <referencenumber>job-uuid</referencenumber>
    <url>https://rankora.co/careers/company-slug/jobs/job-uuid</url>
    <company>Company Name</company>
    <city>San Francisco</city>
    <state>CA</state>
    <country>US</country>
    <description><![CDATA[Full job description here]]></description>
    <salary>$80,000 - $120,000</salary>
    <jobtype>fulltime</jobtype>
  </job>
</source>
```

Implementation:
- Accept `?team_id=...` query param
- Fetch career_page_config for the team (must be active)
- Fetch all published, non-expired jobs for the team
- Generate XML feed
- Return with `Content-Type: application/xml`

### Job Distribution Panel — `src/components/JobDistributionPanel.tsx`

A section in JobDetailView (or as a dialog) showing distribution options for a job.

Props: `jobId, jobTitle, slug, careerPageActive`

Features:
- **Google Jobs**: Status indicator (green if JSON-LD present on career page, with link to test in Google Rich Results Test)
- **Indeed**: Copy the Indeed XML feed URL for submission to Indeed's publisher program
- **LinkedIn**: "Share on LinkedIn" button with pre-filled text + URL
- **Twitter/X**: "Share on X" button with pre-filled text
- **Facebook**: "Share on Facebook" button
- **Copy Job Link**: copy the career page job detail URL
- **QR Code**: generate a QR code (simple SVG-based) for the job URL (useful for job fairs)

### Integration

- Add `JobDistributionPanel` to JobDetailView — new tab "Distribute" or section in the job header
- Add route for Indeed feed in App.tsx or just use the edge function URL directly
- Deploy the indeed-feed edge function

---

## Constraints
- NEVER edit `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts`
- `(supabase as any)` for new tables
- `@/` imports, shadcn-ui only, Sonner toasts
- Public pages (BookInterview, indeed feed) need no auth
- Run `npm run build` — zero TypeScript errors
- ONE migration file: `20260408900000_interview_scheduling.sql`

1	# Instant Resume Ranker (Rankora)

3	AI-powered resume screening SaaS. Users paste a job description, upload resumes, and the system scores/ranks candidates using GPT-4o.

99	
100	## Database Models (Supabase/PostgreSQL)
101	
102	- **profiles** — user_id, credits, plan, inbox_email, email_enabled
103	- **jobs** — user_id, job_description, title, status (pending|processing|completed|failed), scoring weights (must/nice/optional), jd_analysis_json, dynamic_weights_json, jd_embedding (vector)
104	- **resumes** — job_id, filename, file_path, candidate_name, status (pending|done|failed), parsed_json, parsed_text, embedding (vector)
105	- **results** — resume_id, job_id, overall_score, skill_score, experience_score, education_score, missing_skills[], red_flags, matched_must_haves, missing_must_haves, category_scores_json, confidence, hard_fit, strengths_json, gaps_json, explanation_json, interview_questions[]
106	- **users / user_roles** — auth + role enum (admin|user), helper: has_role(), is_job_owner()
107	- **plans** — name, price, credits, billing_type, dodo_product_id, active
108	- **credit_packs** — name, price, credits, active, is_trial, dodo_product_id, dodo_credit_entitlement_id
109	- **payments** — user_id, amount, credits_purchased, status, dodo_payment_id
110	- **feature_flags** — key (unique), enabled, label, description, value_json, category
111	- **platform_config** — singleton: max_resumes_per_job, max_file_size_mb, resume_retention_days, email_ingestion_enabled, payg_per_resume_cost
112	- **ranking_config** — system prompt, model name, temperature, weights
113	- **seo_settings / seo_pages** — meta tags, OG, structured data, analytics
114	- **email_templates** — customizable outbound emails
115	- **admin_audit_logs** — admin_user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details
116	- **feedback / score_versions** — model evaluation data
117	- **email_ingest_logs** — user_id, job_id, sender, status, attachments_count
118	- **usage_logs** — user_id, job_id, credits_used
119	- **subscription_webhooks** — Dodo Payments webhook audit trail
120	
121	## Component Dependency Map
122	
123	```
124	App.tsx → AuthProvider → QueryClientProvider → BrowserRouter
125	├── Index.tsx
126	│   ├── AppHeader (useAuth, useNavigate)
127	│   ├── JobSidebar (pastJobs[], selectedJobId, onSelectJob, onDeleteJob)
128	│   ├── JobDetailView (useAuth, usePlatformConfig, useFeatureFlags)
129	│   │   ├── ScoreSummaryCards (results[])
130	│   │   ├── CandidateRow (result, resume, expanded, onToggle)
131	│   │   └── AuthDialog → AuthForm
132	│   └── AuthDialog
133	├── Auth.tsx → AppHeader, AuthForm
134	├── Settings.tsx → AppHeader, AccountInfoCard, EmailInboxCard, ChangePasswordCard, UsageHistoryCard, PaymentHistoryCard
135	├── Admin.tsx → AppHeader, AdminSidebar, [DashboardTab|UsersTab|BillingTab|...]
136	└── NotFound.tsx
137	```
138	
139	## Architecture Rules
140	
141	1. **Auth-first:** All data access uses Supabase RLS policies. Never bypass auth.
142	2. **shadcn-ui only:** Use components from `src/components/ui/`. No other UI libraries.
143	3. **Path aliases:** Always import with `@/` prefix (maps to `src/`).
144	4. **React Query:** All server state via React Query hooks. No raw `useEffect` for data fetching.
145	5. **Single Supabase client:** Import from `@/integrations/supabase/client.ts`. Never create new clients.
146	6. **Edge Functions:** Business logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno). Frontend calls via `supabase.functions.invoke()`.
147	7. **Credits system:** All ranking operations deduct credits via `deduct_credits()` DB function.
148	8. **Admin audit:** Log all admin mutations via `logAuditAction()` from `@/lib/auditLog.ts`.
149	9. **No hardcoded secrets:** All keys via environment variables (VITE_ prefix for frontend).
150	10. **Auto-generated types:** `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` is auto-generated. Do not manually edit.
151	11. **Sonner toasts:** Use `toast.success()`, `toast.error()` from sonner. No other notification system.
152	12. **Error handling:** Try-catch with toast for user-facing errors. Validation errors as arrays displayed inline.
153	13. **Real-time subscriptions:** Feature flags and SEO settings use Supabase real-time subscriptions + React Query invalidation.
154	
155	## Key Data Flows
156	
157	### Resume Ranking Pipeline
158	```
159	User enters JD + uploads files
160	→ validateFields() checks input
161	→ Create job record (status: pending)
162	→ analyzeJd() → analyze-jd edge function → stores jd_analysis_json
163	→ uploadFilesFromSnapshot() → Supabase Storage + resume records
164	→ rank-resumes edge function (GPT-4o scoring, skill matching)
165	→ rankAndPoll() polls job.status every 2s (max 60 iterations)
166	→ Fetch results from results table
167	→ Merge with resume data, sort by overall_score desc
168	→ Display ScoreSummaryCards + CandidateRow list
169	→ refreshProfile() updates credit count
170	```
171	
172	### Credit System
173	```
174	Check profiles.credits ≥ required
175	→ deduct_credits(user_id, amount) [atomic DB function]
176	→ Log to usage_logs
177	→ Proceed with AI operation
178	→ On failure: no auto-refund (credits already deducted)
179	```
180	
181	### Payment Flows
182	```
183	One-time: BuyCreditsDialog → create-dodo-checkout → redirect to Dodo hosted checkout → dodo-webhook → add credits → PaymentCallback verifies
184	Subscription: SubscriptionDialog → create-dodo-checkout (subscription product) → Dodo checkout → dodo-webhook → update plan+credits
185	Cancellation: cancel-dodo-subscription → plan active until subscription_ends_at → check-expired-subscriptions (cron) → downgrade to free
186	```
187	
188	## Known Code Patterns
189	
190	- **Polling pattern:** `rankAndPoll()` in JobDetailView uses setInterval with iteration counter
191	- **Ref tracking:** `rankingFilesRef` and `resultsRef` track state outside React lifecycle
192	- **Feature flag defaults:** `useFeatureFlag()` returns `enabled: false` before loading (race condition potential)
193	- **SEO type workaround:** `(supabase as any)` cast for seo_settings/seo_pages (not in auto-generated types)
194	- **Dodo hosted checkout:** Both BuyCreditsDialog and SubscriptionDialog use create-dodo-checkout for redirect-based payment
195	- **Admin section mapping:** `sectionComponents` object in Admin.tsx maps section names to components
196	
197	## Commands
198	
199	```bash
200	npm install          # Install dependencies
201	npm run dev          # Start dev server (localhost:8080)
202	npm run build        # Production build
203	npm run test         # Run tests (Vitest)
204	npm run test:watch   # Watch mode tests
205	npx eslint .         # Lint
206	
207	# Supabase
208	supabase functions deploy <name>
209	supabase db push
210	supabase gen types typescript --project-id zkzontawprihrzpayeam > src/integrations/supabase/types.ts
211	```
212	
213	## Safety Rules (CRITICAL)
214	
215	1. **NEVER delete or overwrite existing data/files without explicit user request**
216	2. **NEVER modify payment/billing logic without careful review** — broken payments = lost revenue
217	3. **NEVER change RLS policies without understanding the full security impact**
218	4. **NEVER modify `types.ts`** — it is auto-generated
219	5. **NEVER hardcode API keys, URLs with secrets, or credentials**
220	6. **ALWAYS run `npm run build` after changes to verify no type errors**
221	7. **ALWAYS preserve existing error handling** — do not remove try-catch blocks
222	8. **ALWAYS maintain backward compatibility** — existing API contracts must not break
223	9. **When in doubt, ask the user** — never guess about business logic

# Plan: Interview Scheduling + Job Board Posting

## Build Order

### Step 1: DB Migration
File: `supabase/migrations/20260408900000_interview_scheduling.sql`
- availability_slots table (user_id, team_id FK, day_of_week, start/end time, timezone)
- interviews table (job_id, resume_id, interviewer_id, scheduled_at, status, meeting_link, notes)
- booking_tokens table (job_id, resume_id, interviewer_id, token, expires_at, used)
- RLS on all 3 tables
- NOTE: Remove `public.is_team_member` from availability_slots policy — already exists from team migration. Simplify: user can manage own slots, team members can view (use inline subquery not the function since it may differ).

### Step 2: Edge Function — book-interview
File: `supabase/functions/book-interview/index.ts`
- Public endpoint (no JWT required)
- GET ?token=... → returns available slots for next 14 days
- POST { token, selected_time } → creates interview, marks token used, sends confirmation email via Resend
- Uses service role key for DB access

### Step 3: Edge Function — indeed-feed
File: `supabase/functions/indeed-feed/index.ts`
- Public GET ?team_id=...
- Fetches career_page_config + published jobs
- Returns XML in Indeed format
- Content-Type: application/xml

### Step 4: AvailabilitySettings component
File: `src/components/AvailabilitySettings.tsx`
- Props: userId, teamId
- Weekly grid with 7 rows (Mon-Sun)

### Step 5: ScheduleInterviewDialog component
File: `src/components/ScheduleInterviewDialog.tsx`
- Props: open, onOpenChange, jobId, resumeId, candidateName, candidateEmail
- Interviewer selector (from team members)

### Step 6: InterviewsPanel component

### Step 7: BookInterview public page

- lazy import

### Step 13: npm run build — fix any type errors

- (supabase as any) for all new tables (not in types.ts)
- No modification to types.ts
- React Query for all data fetching
- Sonner toasts only

- Public pages need no auth

-- ============================================================
-- INTERVIEW SCHEDULING: Availability, Interviews, Booking Tokens
-- ============================================================

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. AVAILABILITY SLOTS
--    Recruiters define their weekly availability windows.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE public.availability_slots (
  id           uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id      uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  team_id      uuid REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  day_of_week  integer NOT NULL CHECK (day_of_week BETWEEN 0 AND 6), -- 0=Sun, 6=Sat
  start_time   time NOT NULL,
  end_time     time NOT NULL,
  timezone     text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC',
  is_active    boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CHECK (start_time < end_time)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_availability_user ON public.availability_slots(user_id, day_of_week);
CREATE INDEX idx_availability_team ON public.availability_slots(team_id);

ALTER TABLE public.availability_slots ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Users manage their own availability
CREATE POLICY "Users can manage own availability"
  ON public.availability_slots FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (user_id = auth.uid());

-- Team members can view any member's availability (for scheduling)
CREATE POLICY "Team members can view team availability"
  ON public.availability_slots FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (
    team_id IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.team_members tm
      WHERE tm.team_id = availability_slots.team_id
        AND tm.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. INTERVIEWS
--    Scheduled interview records.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE public.interviews (
  id               uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  job_id           uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  resume_id        uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.resumes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  interviewer_id   uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  candidate_name   text NOT NULL,
  candidate_email  text,
  scheduled_at     timestamptz NOT NULL,
  duration_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  status           text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled'
                     CHECK (status IN ('scheduled', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'no_show')),
  meeting_link     text,
  notes            text,
  created_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_interviews_job        ON public.interviews(job_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_interviews_resume     ON public.interviews(resume_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_interviews_interviewer ON public.interviews(interviewer_id, scheduled_at);

ALTER TABLE public.interviews ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Team owners and the job owner can view all interviews for a job
CREATE POLICY "Team can view interviews"
  ON public.interviews FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (
    interviewer_id = auth.uid()
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.jobs j
      WHERE j.id = interviews.job_id
        AND (
          j.user_id = auth.uid()
          OR (
            j.team_id IS NOT NULL
            AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.team_members tm
              WHERE tm.team_id = j.team_id AND tm.user_id = auth.uid()
            )
          )
        )
    )
  );

-- Interviewers can manage their own; job owner can manage all for the job
CREATE POLICY "Team can manage interviews"
  ON public.interviews FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (
    interviewer_id = auth.uid()
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.jobs j
      WHERE j.id = interviews.job_id AND j.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- updated_at trigger
CREATE TRIGGER set_interviews_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.interviews
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 3. BOOKING TOKENS
--    Single-use tokens sent to candidates for self-booking.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE public.booking_tokens (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  job_id          uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  resume_id       uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.resumes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  interviewer_id  uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token           text NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(24), 'hex'),
  duration_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  expires_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now() + interval '7 days'),
  used            boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_booking_tokens_token        ON public.booking_tokens(token);
CREATE INDEX idx_booking_tokens_interviewer  ON public.booking_tokens(interviewer_id);

ALTER TABLE public.booking_tokens ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Interviewers manage their own tokens
CREATE POLICY "Interviewers can manage own tokens"
  ON public.booking_tokens FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (interviewer_id = auth.uid());

-- Public read via service role (edge function uses service key)
-- No anon policy needed — edge function bypasses RLS

## What was built

### DB Migration
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/supabase/migrations/20260408900000_interview_scheduling.sql`

Three new tables:
- `availability_slots` — weekly availability windows per user/team, with RLS
- `interviews` — scheduled interview records linked to job+resume+interviewer, with RLS and updated_at trigger
- `booking_tokens` — one-use tokens (24-byte hex) that expire in 7 days, with RLS

### Edge Functions
- `/supabase/functions/book-interview/index.ts` — public GET (fetch available slots for next 14 days from availability minus existing interviews) + POST (confirm booking, mark token used, send confirmation email via Resend if configured)
- `/supabase/functions/indeed-feed/index.ts` — public GET `?team_id=...` returning valid Indeed XML feed from published jobs. Content-Type: `application/xml`

### New Frontend Components
- `/src/components/AvailabilitySettings.tsx` — weekly availability grid (7 rows, toggle + time range pickers + timezone selector), saves via delete+re-insert pattern
- `/src/components/ScheduleInterviewDialog.tsx` — full dialog with interviewer selector (from team members), 14-day date selector, available time slot grid (computed from availability minus booked), duration selector, meeting link, notes, and toggle between "Schedule directly" vs "Send booking link to candidate"
- `/src/components/candidate/InterviewsPanel.tsx` — list of interviews for a candidate with status badges (scheduled/completed/cancelled/no_show), status change dropdown (mark complete, no-show, cancel), inline "Schedule Interview" button
- `/src/components/JobDistributionPanel.tsx` — Google Jobs status + test link, Indeed XML feed URL copy, LinkedIn/Twitter/Facebook share buttons (open in popup), direct job link copy, QR code via qrserver.com API (lazy-loaded image, no new npm deps), setup prompt when career page not configured
- `/src/pages/BookInterview.tsx` — public page at `/book/:token`, fetches slots from edge function, shows candidate detail form (name/email), date-grouped time slot grid, confirm button, success screen, expired/used/error states

### Integrations
- `App.tsx` — `/book/:token` route added as public (outside MaintenanceGate), lazy-loaded
- `CandidateDetailSheet.tsx` — "Schedule" button added to action bar (alongside Email/Call/Resume), `InterviewsPanel` added before InterviewQuestionsPanel, `ScheduleInterviewDialog` mounted at bottom
- `JobDetailView.tsx` — "Distribute" tab added as 4th tab, `JobDistributionPanel` rendered in distribute tab content with jobId/title/slug/teamId/careerPageActive props
- `Settings.tsx` — `AvailabilitySettings` card added between ChangePasswordCard and the signout card
